✨ Welcome to the brand-new ATX DIWALI & GARBA! ✨

About this Event

✨🌟 ATX DIWALI & GARBA 🌟✨

✨ Welcome to the brand-new ATX DIWALI & GARBA! ✨
Austin’s newest indoor Diwali & Garba celebration, thoughtfully designed for a fun, vibrant, and family-friendly festival experience. 🪔💃

Enjoy:
🅿️ Free parking
🏟️ Spacious indoor venue for a comfortable, weather-proof experience
🛡️ Enhanced security & controlled entry for added peace of mind
🎤 Built-in professional stage
🔊 State-of-the-art sound system
💡 Large LED screen for an immersive festival experience
Celebrate Diwali and dance Garba indoors, comfortably and safely ( full security & cops ) , with a well-managed environment where you can focus on what matters most—music, culture, family, and fun! ❤️✨

🗓️ Date: October 9, Friday
⏰ Time: 4pm to 10pm
📍 Venue: Northpoint church, Leander ( 10860 E Crystal Falls Pkwy, Building 10, Leander, TX 78641
🎉 FREE ENTRY ( 4 PM - 7 PM, except Garba )
💃 GARBA DANCE (7 PM - 10 PM ) TICKETS REQUIRED
👨‍👩‍👧 Parents: Must purchase General Entry Tickets for ages 3+
🚫 Note: No strollers allowed inside.
⚠️ Children are the responsibility of their parents/guardians at all times.
💡 Plenty of FREE parking available at the premises!

✨ Join us for Livvie Star Co.'s 6th Annual Diwali & Garba Celebration! ✨
A spectacular, family-friendly event to immerse yourself in the vibrant cultural heritage of India. Let’s light up the night together with fresh ideas, exciting performances, and unforgettable moments!

🌟 Event Highlights:
🎭 Entertainment: All-day mesmerizing performances by talented artists. Groove to DJ's music during Bollywood Garba Night and end the evening with a Bollywood blast.
🛍️ Shopping: Discover handcrafted treasures—clothing, jewelry, and décor—perfect for Karva Chauth & Diwali!
🍴 Food & Drinks: Relish authentic Indian cuisine.
🌸 Henna Art: Intricate Mehndi designs to adorn your hands before Karva Chauth Festival.
🎈 Kids' Corner: Face painting, balloon twisting, and crafts!
